cities.name: Rishikesh
cities.line: Homes a short walk from the Ganga, in Tapovan and along the river road.

cities.name: Dehradun
cities.line: Flats at Doon Square, for slower weeks in the valley.

cities.name: Gurgaon
cities.line: A city base for work trips and long stays.

stays.name: Cozy Tapovan
stays.summary: A warm, plant-filled flat in Tapovan, close to the cafés and yoga schools.
stays.description: Cozy Tapovan is set up for slow mornings: soft light, plenty of plants, a kitchen you can actually cook in and a living room made for doing nothing. Tapovan's cafés and yoga schools are close by.

stays.name: Tranquil
stays.summary: A calm, light-filled flat in the same building as Cozy Tapovan.
stays.description: Tranquil is the quieter of our Tapovan homes, with clean lines, white linen and room to read or stretch. Book it alongside Cozy Tapovan when you're travelling with a bigger group.

stays.name: Serenity
stays.summary: A quiet home at 85 Ganges, made for long, unhurried stays.
stays.description: Serenity is at 85 Ganges in Rishikesh. It has a full kitchen, comfortable beds and the quiet the name promises.

stays.name: The Rishikesh House
stays.summary: Three bedrooms for families and groups who want to stay together.
stays.description: Our largest home in Rishikesh, with three bedrooms, a shared living space and a kitchen big enough for everyone to cook together. A good fit for families, retreats and friends travelling as a group.

stays.name: Doon Square 572
stays.summary: A bright flat at Doon Square with everything you need for a longer stay.
stays.description: A comfortable, practical flat at Doon Square for travellers who want a home base, whether you're here for a week or a month.

stays.name: Doon Vista Studio
stays.summary: A stylish studio with mountain views and a private balcony, a minute's walk from IT Park.
stays.description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located studio. The bedroom opens onto a private balcony with mountain views, and there's a dedicated workspace, air conditioning and a kitchen where you can cook your own meals. IT Park is about a one-minute walk away, with Dehradun's cafés and sights a short drive from here.
highlights: IT Park is about a 1-minute walk away, with Dehradun's cafés and sights a drive from here.
Step out for fresh air and mountain views, with seating for two.
Recent guests often mention how helpful and responsive the hosting is.
amenityGroups: Essentials: towels, bed sheets, soap and toilet paper
Kitchen where you can cook your own meals

Long-term stays of 28 days or more
extraRules: As per the society's rules and security guidelines, accommodation for foreign nationals is not permitted at the property. We appreciate your understanding; this policy is in place for the safety and security of all residents and guests.

stays.name: The Gurgaon Flat
stays.summary: A one-bedroom city flat for work trips and longer stays.
stays.description: A calm one-bedroom in Gurgaon with Wi-Fi and a kitchen, so a work trip feels less like a hotel stay.
